payload.claim: When package() opens a draft PR in the exhausted mode, outcome.state (and the ledger row) ends up EXHAUSTED even though the task now carries an open pull request with unanswered blockers awaiting the operator's review — exactly the situation DESIGN.md §6 (line ~1304) says SETTLED_STATES is defined to exclude ('Neither has a task whose outcome still waits on the operator'), which is why READY_FOR_REVIEW/APPROVED/MERGE_TRAIN are carved out of SETTLED_STATES in saffron/scheduler.py (DONE_STATES minus DEPENDENCY_WAITING_STATES). EXHAUSTED stays in SETTLED_STATES unconditionally, so this new EXHAUSTED-with-open-PR task is counted as a decided, non-waiting outcome in trailing_accept_rate (saffron/report/index.py:196-205) even though nobody has reviewed it yet, and since reconcile never promotes EXHAUSTED to MERGED (acknowledged elsewhere in this task's own scope note), it can never later correct itself even if the operator merges the PR by hand — permanently undercounting the accept rate for exactly the tasks this spec adds.
